Indicator 4a1 measures the proportion of patients with atrial fibrillation and an indication for anticoagulation therapy who are actually receiving treatment one year after their index date [^src1]. The national standard sets a target of at least 90% for this indicator [^src1]. In the 2022/23 reporting period, the national average for [[danmark|Danmark]] was 89.1%, meaning the country as a whole missed the target [^src1]. 

At the regional level, only [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] met the national standard, achieving 92.1% [^src1]. The other regions fell short, with [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] coming closest at 89.2%, followed by [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] at 88.8%, [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] at 88.7%, and [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] at 88.2% [^src1].

Performance varies significantly across health clusters. The highest-performing clusters (leaders) were [[klynge-vest|Klynge VEST]] at 94.7%, [[klynge-syd|Klynge SYD]] at 92.7%, [[klynge-midt|Klynge MIDT]] at 92.3%, and Nordjylland at 92.1% [^src1]. Other clusters meeting the ≥90% target included [[sundhedsklynge-bornholm|Sundhedsklynge Bornholm]] (91.8%), [[horsensklyngen|Horsensklyngen]] (91.3%), [[randersklyngen|Randersklyngen]] (91.2%), [[klynge-nord|Klynge NORD]] (90.8%), [[sundhedsklynge-lillebaelt|Sundhedsklynge Lillebælt]] (90.4%), and [[sundhedsklyngen-suh|Sundhedsklyngen SUH]] (90.3%) [^src1]. 

Conversely, the lowest-performing clusters (trailers) were [[sundhedsklyngen-nykoebing-f|Sundhedsklyngen Nykøbing F]] at 85.1%, [[sundhedsklynge-soenderjylland|Sundhedsklynge Sønderjylland]] at 87.2%, and both [[sundhedsklynge-fyn|Sundhedsklynge Fyn]] and [[goedstrupklyngen|Gødstrupklyngen]] at 87.4% [^src1].

Looking at trends across the three reported years (2020/21, 2021/22, and 2022/23), the national average remained relatively flat but dipped slightly in the most recent year (89.4% to 89.8% to 89.1%) [^src1]. [[klynge-vest|Klynge VEST]] showed the most dramatic improvement, rising from 90.6% in 2020/21 to 94.7% in 2022/23 [^src1]. In contrast, [[sundhedsklyngen-nykoebing-f|Sundhedsklyngen Nykøbing F]] exhibited severe volatility; after jumping from 84.6% in 2020/21 to 91.1% in 2021/22, it plummeted back to 85.1% in 2022/23, making it a significant outlier [^src1]. [[klynge-syd|Klynge SYD]] also demonstrated notable recent improvement, climbing from a sub-target 89.9% in 2021/22 to 92.7% in 2022/23 [^src1].
